Now let me run a churn analysis query. For customer churn, I need to identify customers who have placed orders in the past but have not ordered recently. Let me look at:
1. The date range of orders to understand the time period
2. Identify customers who ordered in earlier periods but not in the most recent period(s)

Let me first get an overview of the order dates to understand the time range.

input.query:
WITH date_range AS (
    SELECT 
        MIN(o_orderdate) as earliest_order,
        MAX(o_orderdate) as latest_order
    FROM orders
),
quarterly_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        o_custkey,
        DATE_TRUNC('quarter', o_orderdate) as order_quarter,
        COUNT(*) as order_count,
        SUM(o_totalprice) as total_spent
    FROM orders
    GROUP BY o_custkey, DATE_TRUNC('quarter', o_orderdate)
),
customer_activity AS (
    SELECT 
        o_custkey,
        MIN(o_orderdate) as first_order,
        MAX(o_orderdate) as last_order,
        COUNT(*) as total_orders,
        SUM(o_totalprice) as lifetime_value
    FROM orders
    GROUP BY o_custkey
),
churned_customers AS (
    SELECT 
        c.*,
        ca.first_order,
        ca.last_order,
        ca.total_orders,
        ca.lifetime_value,
        DATE_TRUNC('quarter', ca.last_order) as last_order_quarter,
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE((SELECT latest_order FROM date_range), ca.last_order)) * 4 + 
        EXTRACT(MONTH FROM AGE((SELECT latest_order FROM date_range), ca.last_order)) / 3 as quarters_since_last_order
    FROM customer c
    JOIN customer_activity ca ON c.c_custkey = ca.o_custkey
    ORDER BY quarters_since_last_order DESC, lifetime_value DESC
)
SELECT 
    c_custkey,
    c_name,
    c_mktsegment,
    n_name as nation,
    first_order,
    last_order,
    total_orders,
    lifetime_value,
    quarters_since_last_order,
    CASE 
        WHEN quarters_since_last_order >= 4 THEN 'Churned (4+ quarters)'
        WHEN quarters_since_last_order >= 2 THEN 'At Risk (2-3 quarters)'
        ELSE 'Active'
    END as churn_status
FROM churned_customers
JOIN nation ON c_nationkey = n_nationkey
ORDER BY quarters_since_last_order DESC, lifetime_value DESC

WITH date_bounds AS (
  SELECT 
    MAX(o_orderdate) AS max_date,
    MAX(o_orderdate) - INTERVAL '1 year' AS cutoff_date
  FROM orders
),
customer_orders AS (
  SELECT 
    c.c_custkey,
    c.c_mktsegment,
    CASE

    COUNT(o.o_orderkey) AS order_count,

  GROUP BY c.c_custkey, c.c_mktsegment
)

  COUNT(*) AS customer_count,
  ROUND(AVG(avg_order_value), 2) AS avg_order_value,
  SUM(order_count) AS total_orders,
  ROUND(SUM(order_count) * 1.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS orders_per_customer
